complexity.notes: divmod(n, row_length) is a tidier spelling of the index mapping. The final return expression works but is hard to read; `return nums(start) == target` says the same thing directly since start < end is guaranteed when the loop exits (m, n >= 1 keeps end >= 1 and the loop preserves start < end). This already meets the O(log(m*n)) target.
complexity.summary: Treats the matrix as one sorted array of length m*n and runs a single binary search over virtual indices, mapping each index back to (row, col) via // and %.
